text.content:
Metal is better than meat.

Turf: Northside Industrial District, pushing south into Kabuki
Known for: Heavy chrome, smuggling, black-market tech and drugs
Hangouts: The All Foods Factory; the Totentanz club

The ultimate boostergang. Joining means extensive cyberware, meant to strip away the human and show the metal underneath, and their rituals have an almost occult reverence for chrome.

For all that, Maelstrom has built a shrewd criminal empire out of smuggling, black-market technology and drugs.

Gig hooks

  • Maelstrom has something in the All Foods Factory that two corps want. Neither will go in themselves.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.25
